title: Rook pawns
line: Why a pawn on the edge is so often a draw.

steps.text: A pawn on the edge file is a rook pawn. With only the kings and this pawn, a defending king in the corner ahead cannot be driven out.
You have Black. Head for the corner. Reaching c8 in time is enough.

wrong.d7d6: That is too slow: the pawn runs and promotes before your king reaches the corner.
wrong.d7e6: That is too slow: the pawn runs and promotes before your king reaches the corner.
wrong.d7e7: That is too slow: the pawn runs and promotes before your king reaches the corner.

steps.hint: Go toward the corner by the shortest way.
steps.after: Your king reaches the corner or the square beside it, and the pawn cannot get past.

steps.text: If the white king walks into the corner ahead of its pawn, the black king shuts it in. White has no move: stalemate.
Now you have White. Keep the black king out of the corner: step in its way.

wrong.b6a7: Your king stands in front of its own pawn. The black king reaches the squares beside it, and the game is drawn.
wrong.b6c5: That lets the black king reach the corner, and the game is drawn.
wrong.b6b5: That lets the black king reach the corner, and the game is drawn.
wrong.a4a5: The pawn went first. The black king reaches the squares beside the corner, and the game is drawn.

steps.hint: Stand on the square in front of the corner, beside the pawn's path.
steps.after: The black king cannot reach the corner squares. Now the pawn runs.

also.b7b6: That works too. This lesson pushes the pawn now.

steps.after: Your king guards the way, and the pawn walks up to promote.

summary: Against a rook pawn, the defender heads for the corner. The attacker must keep the king out of it.
